Title: Daring the Dawn + Skin of Night

Messages.Author: cyru...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Have a question. Someone played this in our group. If I use daring the
dawn can I also play skin of night to change it from agg. to normal
damage and still take the damage since it's not preventable. We don't
think you can but wanted to post to get the offical ruling.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
cyru...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Have a question. Someone played this in our group.
> If I use daring the dawn can I also play skin of
> night to change it from agg. to normal damage

No. The damage from Daring the Dawn takes place after the action is
resolved (or combat resulting from a block is completed) not during a
combat. Skin of Night is a combat card and can only played during
combat and can only affect damage taken during combat.

> and still take the damage since it's not preventable.

However, cards like Heart of Darkness (Serpentis) that remain on the
vampire and can be used outside of combat can convert the damage to
normal.

Noal McDonald
